question: Does current V2 evidence establish an unattended train -> controlled evaluation -> reject/promote -> release loop, or what exact capability remains missing?

evidence: src/skatai/evaluation/bidding_gameplay_gate.py and related decision modules provide controlled evaluation building blocks.
src/skatai/artifacts/release.py and accepted release evidence provide reproducible packaging building blocks.
The current orchestration control plane initializes experiment_registry.json but has no experiment lifecycle implementation beyond initialization.

No current source path deterministically chains training completion -> controlled evaluation -> predefined statistical decision -> atomic reject/promote -> release publication as one unattended resumable experiment.

decision: REJECT current end-to-end acceptance. Individual training, evaluation and release components exist, but the autonomous experiment-controller link and transactional promotion/rejection lifecycle are not yet implemented and demonstrated end to end.

missing_capability.primary: A persisted, resumable experiment state machine that owns candidate lineage and advances only through preregistered train, integrity, controlled evaluation, statistical decision, promotion/rejection and release stages.
required_properties: no promotion from training loss or anecdotal gameplay

next_action: Implement and test the bounded experiment lifecycle in the V2 orchestrator, then run one complete reject path and one safe promotion simulation before requesting acceptance.
